summary: Lionheart Holdings, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its charter to extend the deadline to complete a business combination from June 20, 2026 to March 20, 2027. In connection with the extension, it entered into non-redemption agreements with unaffiliated institutional investors covering 15,879,072 Class A ordinary shares, in exchange for issuing 3,175,814 new Class A shares upon closing of an initial business combination. This is a routine SPAC extension filing to avoid liquidation, not a special situation. No M&A transaction or activist campaign is underway. What to watch: whether the SPAC finds a target before the extended deadline or liquidates.
